name: select
title: Select
description: A customizable select component based on Radix UI, supporting various sizes and display variants.

docs.lead: A customizable select component based on Radix UI, supporting various sizes and display variants.
docs.usage:
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select"

<Select>
  <SelectTrigger className="w-[180px]">
    <SelectValue placeholder="Theme" />
  </SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent>
    <SelectItem value="light">Light</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="dark">Dark</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="system">System</SelectItem>
  </SelectContent>
</Select>
